steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In February 2025, a guest on Equity Mates described Amcor as one of the biggest packaging businesses, making soft and rigid plastics across growth countries, with products touching items like Panadol packets and Mount Franklin water bottles.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Dawes - Xero, Pilbara Minerals, Resmed & more

views.text: In January 2023, Equity Mates explained Amcor’s two segments: Flexibles with US$11.3 billion sales, 170 plants in 39 countries, and Rigid Plastics with US$3.4 billion sales and 50 plants, supplying chip packets, pet food pouches and water bottles across supermarket aisles.

episode.title: Packaging the world - Amcor | Summer Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In February 2025, a guest on Equity Mates called Amcor one of the biggest global packaging players and said a large US acquisition would make it a world leader, framing it as a defensive business that historically fell less than the market in downturns.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Dawes - Xero, Pilbara Minerals, Resmed & more

views.text: In January 2023, Equity Mates reported profit rose to $805 million from $564 million over five years and said Amcor targeted segments where it believed it held leadership advantages, including protein, health care, premium coffee, pet food and hot fill beverages.

episode.title: Packaging the world - Amcor | Summer Series

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In February 2025, a guest on Equity Mates said Amcor was making a very large US acquisition and expected it to be EPS accretive after integration, positioning the company as a global packaging leader.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Dawes - Xero, Pilbara Minerals, Resmed & more

views.text: In January 2023, Equity Mates said Amcor emphasised heavy R&D spend, describing plans to invest about $1 billion a year in next generation, more sustainable packaging to differentiate from competitors.

episode.title: Packaging the world - Amcor | Summer Series
